doc.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995

title: Walking off from a rude singer at a St. Louis fashion show
summary: He left the piano when a singer gave him a look.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: I’ll never forget, this reminds me of a story. One time I’m playing in St. Louis and it was at a fashion show, and they had this gal singer on, oh this goes back in the ‘40s. And this gal was singing, and I’m accompanying her, and she turned around and gave me some stuff like, you know. Well this was something I wouldn’t take. I just got off the piano and walked away and said, “Okay, go ahead and sing,” you know?
I’ll bet she didn’t give the next person she played with the same look. You probably saved someone else some embarrassment down the road.
